```{r}
#install.packages("FAOSTAT")
library(FAOSTAT)
library(tidyverse)
# show code label pairs to load appropriate FAOSTAT dataset
search_dataset()
```

```{r}
# FS = Suite of Food Security Indicators
food_security <- get_faostat_bulk_api("FS")
```

```{r}
# for simplicity, only look at 2024
# give each data category its own column
food_security |> filter(year == "2024") |> pivot_wider(names_from = item) |> group_by(area) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ first(na.omit(.))), .groups = "drop") -> food_short
```

```{r}
food_security |> filter(year == "2024") |> group_by(item) |> summarise(data_completion = n()/nrow(food_short)*100)
```

info on 

```{r}
world_map = map_data("world") %>% 
  filter(! long > 180)

countries = world_map %>% 
  distinct(region) %>% 
  rowid_to_column() 

countries_plus_food <- countries |> merge(food_short, by.x = "region", by.y = "area")
countries_plus_food %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fill = as.numeric(`Average dietary energy requirement (kcal/cap/day)`), map_id = region)) +
  geom_map(map = world_map) +
  expand_limits(x = world_map$long, y = world_map$lat) +
  coord_map("moll") +
  labs(fill = "", title = "Average dietary energy requirement")
```

```{r}
countries_plus_food %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fill = as.numeric(`Incidence of caloric losses at retail distribution level (percent)`), map_id = region)) +
  geom_map(map = world_map) +
  expand_limits(x = world_map$long, y = world_map$lat) +
  coord_map("moll") +
  labs(fill = "", title = "")
```

```{r}
# compare food insecurity between male and female population
# split data into three-year range data and one-year range data
food_security |> filter(str_detect(year, "-"), unit == "%") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = item) |> group_by(year, area) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ first(na.omit(.))), .groups = "drop") |> 
  select(area, year, contains(c("male", "female"))) -> insecurity_gender_range

food_security |> filter(nchar(year) == 4, unit == "%") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = item) |> group_by(year, area) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ first(na.omit(.))), .groups = "drop") |> 
  select(area, year, contains(c("male", "female"))) -> insecurity_gender

# find gaps in data coverage
insecurity_gender_range |> group_by(year) |> summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ mean(is.na(.)) * 100
    )
  )

insecurity_gender |> group_by(year) |> summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ mean(is.na(.)) * 100
    )
  )


insecurity_gender_range <- insecurity_gender_range |> drop_na()
```

100% coverage for data in 3 year range from 2014-2016 onwards
no data prior to 2014
limited data 2014 onwards in 1 year increments

in which I discover that there are in fact data gaps
they're just blanks instead of NA

```{r}
# fill blanks with NA
insecurity_gender_range |> select(-diff) |> mutate_all(na_if, "") |> group_by(year) |> summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ mean(is.na(.)) * 100
    )
  ) 
insecurity_gender_range |> mutate_all(na_if, "")-> insecurity_gender_range
insecurity_gender_range <- insecurity_gender_range |> drop_na()
```

```{r}
# add column for difference between male and female insecurity
insecurity_gender_range$diff <- as.numeric(insecurity_gender_range$`Prevalence of severe food insecurity in the male adult population (percent) (3-year average)`) - as.numeric(insecurity_gender_range$`Prevalence of severe food insecurity in the female adult population (percent) (3-year average)`)

insecurity_gender_range |> filter(year == "2023-2025") |> ggplot(aes(fill = diff, map_id = region)) + geom_map(map = world_map, color = "grey") +
  expand_limits(x = world_map$long, y = world_map$lat) +
  coord_map("moll") + labs(fill = "Insecurity Gender Gap") + scale_fill_gradient2()
```


```{r}
insecurity_gender_range |> group_by(year) |> 
  mutate(rank = row_number(desc(diff))) -> insecurity_gender_range

insecurity_gender_range |> select(region, year, diff, rank) |> arrange(rank)
```

```{r}
insecurity_gender_range |> select(region, rank, year) |> filter(rank < 130) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = region,
    names_sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank)

insecurity_gender_range |> select(region, rank, year) |> filter(rank > 130) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = region,
    names_sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank)

insecurity_gender_range |> group_by(region) |> summarise(ave_rank = mean(rank, na.rm = T)) |> arrange(ave_rank)

insecurity_gender_range |> filter(region %in% c("Libya")) |> select(region, rank, year, diff)
```

Togo went from highest diff w/ high MFI for 10 years to 61st in 2023-2025
Malasia has consistently high MFI
Ireland has ~1.5% diff consistently

Botswana has consistently high FFI ~-4-5%
Afghanistan had -2 2015-2017, increasing to -10 2018-2020 and holding

Libya inconsistent: -4.3 in 2014-2016, -10 2018-2021, 4.9 in 2023-2025
